北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，记得多穿衣物，注意防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and chilly, remember to dress warmly and stay hydrated!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云但很冷，湿度大，注意保暖防潮，别感冒了。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy and cold with high humidity. Stay warm and dry.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全，添衣保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy, visibility is low. Drive safe and dress warm.
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，湿度较高，穿着舒适就好，享受好天气。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and humid. Dress comfortably and enjoy the day.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温宜人，湿度也高，祝您有个愉快的一天！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and mild with high humidity. Have a pleasant day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，能见度不高，出行注意安全，别忘了多穿点哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, visibility is low. Be careful out there and dress warm!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雾气弥漫，路面湿滑，请小心驾驶，注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy and roads might be damp. Drive carefully and stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都气温低，湿度大，请多添衣物，注意防潮和保暖！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cold and very humid. Dress warmly and beware of dampness.
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，气温很低，请注意防寒防潮，小心慢行哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and cold. Stay warm, watch for dampness, and drive safe.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，气温略凉，注意增减衣物，保持身体舒适。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and a bit cool. Dress in layers to stay comfortable.
西安.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，气温适中，湿度较高，出门愉快，心情舒畅！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and mild with high humidity. Enjoy your day!
重庆.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天冷零下，注意保暖，多穿厚衣服，别冻着了！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing cold. Dress in very warm layers to avoid catching a chill!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有雾，能见度低，气温偏冷，出行注意安全和保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is foggy and cold. Drive safe and dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明气温较低，湿度大，记得多添衣物，小心着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cold and humid. Remember to dress warmly to avoid a chill.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，气温适中但能见度低，出行注意安全哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, visibility is low. Stay safe while traveling.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，气温偏凉，出门请注意防护，多穿衣物。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has haze and is cool. Wear a mask, dress warmly, and stay safe.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，气温低，能见度差，出行注意安全，多保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and cold. Visibility is poor, so travel safely and stay warm!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有雾，气温舒适，但请注意交通安全，小心驾驶。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is foggy and mild. Drive carefully and safely.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪气温较低，湿度大，请注意防潮保暖，小心着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cold and humid. Stay warm and watch out for dampness.
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃
